title: 第5章 招募队友
slug: 从素晴开始成为海贼王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

红魔族与普通人不同，学生时期就能拥有自己的冒险者卡片，但这并不意味着拥有冒险者身份。

两人来到冒险者公会，正是为了注册成为冒险者，以便接取任务赚取赏金维持生活。

惠惠本想趁人多的时候，好好炫耀一番自己大魔法师的职业，顺便借此加入某个冒险者小队，偏偏此时公会里一个冒险者都没有，因此决定再等一等。

悠悠倒是没那么多顾虑，先一步办完手续，正式成为了冒险者。

林北并没有理会这两人，而是向招待大姐姐借了纸和笔，自顾自地写起了招募队友的告示。

悠悠注意到了林北的行为。

她很好奇对方在写什么，但碍于社恐的性格，并不敢立刻上前搭话。

直到林北把写好的告示贴到公告栏上且离开公会后，她才鼓起勇气凑过去细看。

内容是这样的：

招募可以互相信任的伙伴，人数与职业不限。

最好拥有一定的航海经验，若没有航海经验，则至少擅长以下任意一种副业。

厨师、医生、船匠、绘图、锻造，或者其它一切能在航海时用上的技能。

本人是经验丰富的海员，能带船，目标是抓海贼，赚赏金。

感兴趣的人可在告示上留下签名与方便见面的时间地点，约谈详情。

招募人——林北。

悠悠不由得心生困惑。

大海？这里距离大海应该很远吧，为什么要在这种地方招募船员？真的会有人应聘吗？

她拿起笔，犹豫着要不要在告示上留下自己的名字。

想了很久，终究还是没写。

不过，她也找招待大姐姐借了纸和笔，也写了一张招募队友的告示，挨着林北的那张，整整齐齐地贴在了下面。

这样一来，他一定会注意到我的吧？

离开冒险者公会后，林北并没有闲逛。

他先是打听到了建材商铺的位置，仔细询问了造船材料的价格。

阿克塞尔有一条贯穿全城的大河，水上运输业规模不小。

虽然没有正经的造船厂，但凭借前世的航海经验，他还是大致估算出了造一艘海船所需的费用。

即便一切从简，保守估计也要一亿厄里斯打底，短时间内根本不可能凑齐。

他又将厄里斯的购买力与黄金进行对比，再换算成海贼世界通用的贝利，发现两个世界的货币汇率居然相差无几。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Unlike ordinary people, the Red Devils can have their own adventurer cards when they are students, but this does not mean they have adventurer status.

The two came to the Adventurer's Guild just to register as adventurers so that they could take on tasks and earn bounties to support themselves.

Megumin originally wanted to show off her profession as a great magician while there were many people, and join a certain adventurer team by the way. However, there was not a single adventurer in the guild at this time, so she decided to wait a little longer.

Yuyou didn't have so many worries, she completed the formalities first and officially became an adventurer.

Lin Bei ignored these two people. Instead, he borrowed paper and pen from the host sister and wrote a notice to recruit teammates.

Youyou noticed Lin Bei's behavior.

She was very curious about what the other person was writing, but due to her fearful personality, she did not dare to speak immediately.

It wasn't until Lin Bei posted the written notice on the bulletin board and left the guild that she mustered up the courage to go over and take a closer look.

The content is as follows:

Recruit partners who can trust each other. There is no limit on the number and profession.

It is best to have some sailing experience. If you have no sailing experience, you should be good at at least one of the following side jobs.

Cook, doctor, shipwright, draftsman, blacksmith, or any other skill that can be used while sailing.

I am an experienced seaman who can lead a ship. My goal is to catch pirates and earn bounties.

Interested parties can leave their signature on the notice and provide a convenient time and place to meet and discuss the details.

Recruiter——Lin Bei.

Youyou couldn't help but feel confused.

The sea?This place should be far away from the sea. Why do we need to recruit crew members in a place like this?Will anyone actually apply?

She picked up the pen and hesitated to write her name on the notice.

After thinking about it for a long time, I still didn’t write it.

However, she also borrowed paper and pen from the host sister, and wrote a notice recruiting teammates, and neatly pasted it next to Lin Bei's notice.

In this way, he will definitely notice me, right?

After leaving the Adventurer's Guild, Lin Bei did not hang around.

He first found out the location of the building materials store and carefully inquired about the price of shipbuilding materials.

Axel has a large river that runs through the city, and the water transportation industry is quite large.

Although there is no serious shipyard, he can roughly estimate the cost of building a sea-going ship based on his sailing experience in his previous life.

Even if everything is kept simple, it is conservatively estimated to cost 100 million Eris, which is impossible to collect in a short time.

He then compared the purchasing power of Eris with gold, and then converted it into the Bailey used in the pirate world, and found that the currency exchange rates of the two worlds were almost the same.
